think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value (e.g., -1, 0) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/enable/auto/sentinel), i.e., not just ‘smaller/larger’. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as non-special.
